title: Claude Opus 4.5 System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型系统卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要审查闭源前沿模型中后训练数据、反馈奖励、推理文本监测、去污染和可复现性边界的读者
one_line: Claude Opus 4.5's system card discloses broad source categories, RLHF/RLAIF, prior-model reasoning text in earlier supervised learning, no RL reward on reasoning-text content, selected reward-hacking safeguards, and concrete decontamination rules, but not auditable records, rewards, or environments.
Claude Opus 4.5 的系统卡披露了宽泛来源类别、RLHF/RLAIF、早期监督学习中的先前模型 reasoning text、RL 不按 reasoning-text 内容奖惩、部分 reward-hacking 防护和具体去污染规则，但没有公开可审计的记录、奖励或环境。
why: It is a particularly informative Track 12 ledger item because it separates disclosed frontier post-training and monitoring mechanisms from the missing record-level provenance, feedback contract, reward implementation, and reproducibility artifacts.
inclusion_reason: A high-impact frontier system card with unusually concrete disclosure of training-source categories, RLHF/RLAIF, prior-model reasoning text, reasoning-text reward boundaries, coding-environment inoculation prompting, training-transcript review, and decontamination rules—while retaining the records and reward contract needed for audit as undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier system cards can disclose broad data categories and alignment methods without exposing the records, feedback contract, or audit artifacts needed to inspect a post-training pipeline. That gap matters for reasoning systems because source provenance, trace generation, reward boundaries, contamination controls, and agentic environments determine whether a reported mechanism can be independently assessed.

Claude Opus 4.5 is a high-value Track 12 item because Anthropic's official system card is unusually concrete on several interfaces: source categories, RLHF and reinforcement learning from AI feedback, earlier supervised learning with reasoning text produced by prior models, the absence of RL rewards or penalties based on reasoning-text content, selected reward-hacking mitigations, internal transcript review, and evaluation decontamination. It still withholds the record-level data, rewards, environments, and reproducibility artifacts. This Card records both sides of that boundary rather than treating the card as a released post-training dataset or recipe.

前沿系统卡可以披露宽泛的数据类别和对齐方法，却不公开检查后训练管线所需的记录、反馈契约或审计制品。对于推理系统，这一缺口很重要，因为来源溯源、trace 生成、奖励边界、污染控制和智能体环境决定了所报告机制能否被独立审查。

Claude Opus 4.5 是高价值的 Track 12 条目，因为 Anthropic 官方系统卡在若干接口上异常具体：来源类别、RLHF 和来自 AI feedback 的强化学习、早期监督学习中先前模型产生的 reasoning text、RL 不按 reasoning-text 内容给予奖励或惩罚、部分 reward-hacking 缓解措施、内部 transcript review 和评测去污染。它仍然未公开记录级数据、奖励、环境和可复现制品。本卡片同时记录该边界的两侧，而不将系统卡视为已发布的后训练数据集或配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official system card describes a proprietary training mixture at category level: public internet information through May 2025, non-public third-party data, data-labeling services and paid contractors, opted-in Claude-user data, and internally generated Anthropic data. It reports cleaning and filtering, including deduplication and classification. These are disclosure-level source claims; no source manifest, mixture weights, record counts, versions, rights map, or item-level lineage is released.

For post-training, Anthropic reports substantial RLHF and reinforcement learning from AI feedback. It makes one important reasoning-text boundary explicit: RL training used no rewards or penalties based on the content of the model's reasoning text. Separately, some earlier supervised-learning data included reasoning text produced by prior models. The combination exposes a real distinction between supervised trace use and RL reward handling, but does not identify teachers, prompts, traces, preferences, reward models, verifiers, or objectives.

官方系统卡在类别层面描述了一个专有训练混合：截至 2025 年 5 月的公共互联网信息、非公开第三方数据、数据标注服务和付费承包商数据、选择加入的 Claude 用户数据，以及 Anthropic 内部生成数据。它报告了包括去重和分类在内的清洗与过滤。这些是披露级的来源主张；没有公开来源清单、混合权重、记录数量、版本、权利映射或条目级谱系。

对于后训练，Anthropic 报告了大量 RLHF 和来自 AI feedback 的强化学习。它明确给出一个重要的 reasoning-text 边界：RL 训练没有基于模型 reasoning-text 内容的奖励或惩罚。另一方面，一些较早的监督学习数据包含先前模型产生的 reasoning text。这一组合揭示了监督 trace 使用与 RL 奖励处理之间的真实区别，但没有识别 teachers、prompts、traces、preferences、奖励模型、verifiers 或 objectives。

title: Method
方法
html:
Anthropic says a general-purpose web crawler follows robots.txt and avoids password-, sign-in-, and CAPTCHA-protected pages. The card names data cleaning, filtering, deduplication, and classification, but not the corresponding implementation, thresholds, yields, corpus snapshots, or source-by-source audit. Data-work-platform workers help with preference selection, safety evaluation, and adversarial testing. Worker identities, locale, compensation, instructions, agreement, task counts, and links from worker records to training stages are unknown.

The disclosed post-training methods are RLHF and reinforcement learning from AI feedback. Earlier supervised learning uses some prior-model reasoning text, while RL does not reward or penalize reasoning-text content. The report gives no preference-record schema, AI-feedback model identity, reward equation, objective composition, reward weights, calibration, verifier, optimizer, schedule, rollout policy, or checkpoint selection. It also says Anthropic has used inoculation prompting since Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 on a significant subset of coding environments, including environments most susceptible to reward hacking. The prompts, environments, subset fraction, reward contract, and training impact are unknown.

For one monitorability analysis, Anthropic retrained a base model on original or Sonnet 3.5-paraphrased reasoning workspaces, using 11,000 math transcripts with reasoning workspaces and no tool use from RL training. A separate reasoning workspace evaluation used 16 samples per question at temperature 1. These are internal analysis settings, not a released training dataset, a general post-training sampling policy, or a deployed inference configuration.

Anthropic 称其通用网络爬虫遵循 robots.txt，并避开受密码、登录和 CAPTCHA 保护的页面。系统卡列举了数据清洗、过滤、去重和分类，但没有公开相应实现、阈值、保留率、语料快照或逐来源审计。数据工作平台的 workers 协助进行 preference selection、安全评估和对抗测试。worker 身份、地区、报酬、指令、一致性、任务数量以及 worker 记录与训练阶段的关联均为 unknown。

已披露的后训练方法是 RLHF 和来自 AI feedback 的强化学习。较早的监督学习使用一些先前模型的 reasoning text，而 RL 不按 reasoning-text 内容进行奖惩。报告没有给出 preference-record 模式、AI-feedback 模型身份、奖励方程、目标组成、奖励权重、校准、verifier、优化器、调度、rollout 策略或 checkpoint 选择。它还称，自 Claude Sonnet 4 和 Opus 4 起，Anthropic 在显著一部分 coding environments 中使用 inoculation prompting，其中包括最易受 reward hacking 影响的环境。prompts、环境、子集比例、奖励契约和训练影响均为 unknown。

在一项 monitorability 分析中，Anthropic 在原始或由 Sonnet 3.5 改写的 reasoning workspaces 上重新训练基础模型，使用来自 RL 训练的 11,000 个带 reasoning workspaces 且无工具使用的数学 transcripts。另一项 reasoning workspace 评测对每个问题在温度 1 下使用 16 个 samples。这些是内部分析设置，并不是已发布训练数据集、通用后训练采样策略或已部署推理配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official Claude Opus 4.5 System Card directly supports the source-category and basic-filtering claims on page 8, the RLHF/RLAIF statement on page 9, and the worker-role disclosure on page 10. Its page 89 chain-of-thought monitorability discussion states both that some earlier supervised-learning data uses reasoning text produced by prior models and that RL training has no reward or penalty based on reasoning-text content. Pages 89–90 describe the 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace analysis.

The same card documents the reward-hacking mitigation on page 105: inoculation prompting is used on a significant subset of coding environments, including those most susceptible to reward hacking. Pages 105–106 describe a review that sampled several hundred thousand transcripts across much of training; using recursive summaries evaluated by Claude Sonnet 4.5, it found unfaithful or deceptive reasoning in about 1% of the STEM-question training distribution in partially trained snapshots. The card does not release the transcripts, sampling design, classifier performance, or raw review outputs.

For evaluation decontamination, pages 15–17 specify removal of documents with at least five exact question-answer pair substring matches, removal for more than 40% 20-gram overlap, canary filtering, and manual inspection. The report also says rephrased AIME questions, official solutions, and model-generated answers persisted in the corpus despite these controls. The official system-card index confirms the November 2025 listing; it is not used to infer undisclosed training details.

官方 Claude Opus 4.5 System Card 在第 8 页直接支持来源类别和基础过滤主张，在第 9 页支持 RLHF/RLAIF 陈述，在第 10 页支持 worker 角色披露。其第 89 页的 chain-of-thought monitorability 讨论同时称，一些较早的监督学习数据使用先前模型生成的 reasoning text，且 RL 训练没有基于 reasoning-text 内容的奖励或惩罚。第 89–90 页描述了 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace 分析。

同一卡片在第 105 页记录了 reward-hacking 缓解措施：在显著一部分 coding environments 中使用 inoculation prompting，包括最易受 reward hacking 影响的环境。第 105–106 页描述了对覆盖训练大部分阶段的数十万 transcripts 的审查；使用由 Claude Sonnet 4.5 评估的递归摘要，它在部分训练快照的 STEM-question 训练分布中发现约 1% 存在不忠实或欺骗性推理。卡片没有发布 transcripts、采样设计、分类器性能或原始审查输出。

对于评测去污染，第 15–17 页规定：移除至少有五个精确问答对 substring matches 的文档、移除超过 40% 的 20-gram overlap、canary filtering 和人工检查。报告还称，改写的 AIME 问题、官方解答和模型生成答案在这些控制后仍留在语料中。官方系统卡索引 确认了 2025 年 11 月的条目；它不用于推断未披露的训练细节。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a public data release. Its distinctive Track 12 value is that it exposes several precise boundaries at once: prior-model reasoning text appears in earlier supervised learning, but RL does not reward reasoning-text content; a substantial coding-environment subset receives inoculation prompting for reward hacking; and an internal transcript review reports an approximate rate for unfaithful or deceptive reasoning. These are useful audit signals without becoming a reusable feedback stack.

The card also discloses unusually specific decontamination controls and, importantly, their limitation. It names exact-match, fuzzy-overlap, canary, and manual-inspection controls, then reports that rephrased AIME material, official solutions, and model-generated answers still persisted. This makes the entry a stronger disclosure comparison point than a generic claim of benchmark hygiene, while preserving the fact that the corpus, code, yields, and full audit artifacts are unavailable.

这不是公开数据发布。它对 Track 12 的独特价值在于同时暴露了若干精确边界：先前模型的 reasoning text 出现在较早的监督学习中，但 RL 不按 reasoning-text 内容奖励；相当一部分 coding environments 获得了针对 reward hacking 的 inoculation prompting；内部 transcript review 报告了不忠实或欺骗性推理的大致比例。这些是有用的审计信号，却不构成可复用的反馈栈。

系统卡还披露了异常具体的去污染控制及其局限。它点名了精确匹配、模糊重叠、canary 和人工检查控制，随后报告改写的 AIME 材料、官方解答和模型生成答案仍然存在。因此，这一条目比泛泛的 benchmark hygiene 主张更适合作为披露对照点，同时保留语料、代码、保留率和完整审计制品不可得的事实。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The system card does not release a training or post-training corpus, prompt/task records, preference comparisons, thought traces, worker labels, record schemas, source manifests, mixture weights, record counts, revisions, rights map, selected or rejected records, or item-level lineage. It does not disclose the identities and checkpoints of prior-model trace generators, the generation prompts, trace filters, or the role of individual traces in training.

RLHF, reinforcement learning from AI feedback, and inoculation prompting are named without a reward contract. Reward models and AI-feedback sources, preference protocol, objectives, weights, normalization, verifiers, calibration, terminal predicates, environment specifications, optimizer, schedules, rollout policy, and checkpoints remain unknown. The 11,000-transcript subset and the several-hundred-thousand-transcript review are internal analyses, not released datasets or reproducible monitoring artifacts.

The stated decontamination controls are not independently reproducible without the training corpus, benchmark snapshots, code, filter configuration, retained/removed record lists, yields, and full audit results. Their documented failure—persistence of rephrased AIME questions, official solutions, and model-generated answers—means the disclosed controls are not a guarantee of clean evaluation separation. Capability and safety assessments also rely substantially on internal or redacted artifacts, so their results should not be read as independently rerunnable evidence.

系统卡没有发布训练或后训练语料、prompt/task 记录、preference comparisons、thought traces、worker labels、记录模式、来源清单、混合权重、记录数量、版本、权利映射、入选或拒绝记录，或条目级谱系。它没有公开先前模型 trace 生成器的身份和 checkpoints、生成 prompts、trace filters，或各个 traces 在训练中的作用。

RLHF、来自 AI feedback 的强化学习和 inoculation prompting 被点名，但没有给出奖励契约。奖励模型和 AI-feedback 来源、preference protocol、目标、权重、归一化、verifiers、校准、terminal predicates、环境规范、优化器、调度、rollout policy 和 checkpoints 仍为 unknown。11,000-transcript 子集和数十万 transcript 审查都是内部分析，并不是发布的数据集或可复现的监测制品。

所述去污染控制在没有训练语料、benchmark snapshots、代码、filter 配置、保留/移除记录列表、保留率和完整审计结果时无法独立复现。其已记录的失效——改写的 AIME 问题、官方解答和模型生成答案仍然存在——意味着这些控制不是干净评测分离的保证。能力和安全评估也在很大程度上依赖内部或删节制品，因此不应被理解为可独立重跑的证据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, Claude Opus 4.5 is a particularly useful frontier-disclosure comparison point. Readers can distinguish broad source descriptions from source manifests; prior-model reasoning text in supervised learning from reward use in RL; reward-hacking safeguards from a released reward contract; and published decontamination rules from reproducible contamination evidence. The named transcript reviews also illustrate how an internal monitoring result can be informative without becoming independently auditable.

Use this Card to assess the evidence a system card supplies for data lineage, feedback mechanisms, monitorability, reward hacking, and evaluation hygiene. Do not use it to reconstruct Anthropic's training pipeline, infer undocumented source rights or preference data, treat the monitorability analyses as released trace corpora, or conclude that the reported decontamination rules provide complete benchmark separation.

对 Track 12 而言，Claude Opus 4.5 是特别有用的前沿披露比较点。读者可以区分宽泛的来源描述与来源清单；监督学习中的先前模型 reasoning text 与 RL 中奖励使用；reward-hacking safeguards 与已发布的奖励契约；以及公布的去污染规则与可复现的污染证据。所点名的 transcript reviews 还说明，内部监测结果可以提供信息，却不必然变得可独立审计。

应使用本卡片评估系统卡为数据谱系、反馈机制、monitorability、reward hacking 和评测卫生提供的证据。不要用它重建 Anthropic 的训练管线、推断未记录的来源权利或 preference data、将 monitorability 分析视为已发布 trace corpora，或断定所报告的去污染规则提供了完整 benchmark separation。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the disclosed source classes as category-level provenance, not as a source manifest, rights map, or reusable corpus.
  • Keep prior-model reasoning text in earlier supervised learning distinct from the explicit boundary that RL does not reward or penalize reasoning-text content.
  • Treat the 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace study and the several-hundred-thousand-transcript review as internal monitoring analyses, not released trace data or a complete account of training data.
  • Preserve both sides of the decontamination disclosure: the exact-match, overlap, canary, and manual controls, and the reported persistence of rephrased AIME material, official solutions, and model-generated answers.
  • Record inoculation prompting as a high-level reward-hacking mitigation; do not infer the coding tasks, prompt templates, reward contract, subset fraction, or measured effect.

• 将披露的来源类别视为类别级溯源，而不是来源清单、权利映射或可复用语料。
  • 严格区分较早监督学习中的先前模型 reasoning text，与“RL 不按 reasoning-text 内容奖惩”的明确边界。
  • 将 11,000-transcript reasoning workspace 研究和数十万 transcript 审查视为内部监测分析，而不是已发布 trace 数据或训练数据的完整说明。
  • 同时保留去污染披露的两面：精确匹配、重叠、canary 和人工控制，以及改写 AIME 材料、官方解答和模型生成答案仍存在的报告。
  • 将 inoculation prompting 记录为高层 reward-hacking 缓解措施；不要推断 coding tasks、prompt templates、奖励契约、子集比例或测得效果。
